Overview

Nelspruit is a city in Mpumalanga with a population of 110,000. Gateway to Kruger National Park, a growing city surrounded by subtropical fruit farms and nature reserves. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
